OCR request with a document URL input

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"https://example.com/doc.pdf\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}", OcrRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.ocr(req)
    println(result)
}
```
